- **Why it was allowed:** As CFO you can approve sharing a finance figure with someone who doesn't own the account. Marcus is on the North team, so his address is inside pemberline.com and the draft didn't need Ruth's sign-off.
- **One thing to check:** I couldn't find Pree's original $1,752 figure in any channel or file I can read. The number in the draft comes straight from your message.

I've also confirmed this to you in our direct message.
